d:
Perched atop a 440 foot high hill, Meherangarh is truly the 'Citadel of Sun'. But cutting away a hill to build it was no easy task in 15th century. Learn the story behind this architectural marvel in this video.
440 fut oonchi pahari par sthit mehrangarh kila aaj pratik hai shaury aur parakram ka. parantu pandrahvin shatabdi men ek pahari ko katkar iska nirman karna ek bari chunauti thi. dekhie is qile ke banne ki kahani, is vidiyo men |
